sourceRegistry.scope: Only original external installation recipes are distributed. Each external parser retains its registered upstream license; no blanket MIT or NetAtlas implementation claim.
sourceRegistry.verification: Actual TLS-verified GET bytes plus non-executing node --check and static source-contract review; native application imports and conversion execution are not run.

quantumultX.author: KOP-XIAO

sourceContract.input: QX $resource object: type/link/content/info/tag; $environment.version for host build.
sourceContract.completion: $done({content,...}) and optional native retry response; hashSchema helper UI.

permissions.network: Can request a native User-Agent retry to re-fetch a subscription; configured custom filter/rename scripts run in the same host context.
permissions.storage: The recipe has no storage operations; this is external client code, not an isolated NetAtlas sandbox.

quantumultX.behavior: Converts supported subscription nodes, rules and module/rewrite resources and exposes filtering/renaming options; feature and protocol support follow the external parser.
quantumultX.limitations: The upstream repository does not declare a root license. NetAtlas only publishes an optional original-author URL recipe; no parser source or modified copy is distributed.

loon.author: Peng-YM and Sub-Store contributors

sourceContract.input: Loon $resource string, $resourceType number, $resourceUrl string, $loon and optional $argument.
sourceContract.otherTypes: Passed through; not a general plugin/script rewrite converter.

permissions.network: Product can download $resourceUrl if supplied content cannot be converted; shared download utilities may use subscription caches.
permissions.storage: External bundle runs with Loon host privileges and shared download/cache helpers; no wrapper storage or credential setup.

loon.behavior: Parses node and rule resources into Loon format; enable parser-enabled=true on the chosen existing subscription when conversion is needed.
loon.limitations: The recipe references the official AGPL release bundle without redistributing it. No automatic synchronization or Gist upload hook is installed. The upstream build is not claimed to be reproducible.

unsupportedReason: This feature only supplies the documented QX/Loon resource-parser settings. Other clients may use separate Sub-Store or ScriptHub tools; no equivalent parser-key compatibility is claimed.
